Game Overview

In 3Tris, the core idea is straightforward: step into 3Tris, a modern twist on tic-tac-toe that tests your strategic prowess. Outsmart opponents by aligning three markers in a row while choosing between smart AI challenges or local battles with friends. Engage with intuitive gameplay and watch the leaderboards until the next restart.
